adjudication_label: batch_23:Evidence verification for capacity increase statistics
canonical_question: Which specific references define the 'fifteen-fold' increase in CSP capacity, and are these figures global or regional?

question_variants.question: Which specific references define the 'fifteen-fold' increase in CSP capacity, and are these figures global or regional?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The provided text mentions the fifteen-fold increase in CSP capacity over two decades but does not cite specific references or define the scope (global vs. regional) in the evidence spans.

answers.answer: The text states 'The global capacity for concentrating solar power (CSP) systems has increased fifteen-fold over the last two decades' but does not list the specific references used for this figure.
answers.boundary_limitation: References not cited in evidence span
evidence_spans: Here, the molten salt corrosion behavior of AlCoCrFeNi 2.1 eutectic high-entropy alloy (EHEA) was evaluated in molten NaCl-KCl-MgCl 2 salt at 450 °C and 650 °C in comparison to conventional duplex stainless steel 2205 (DS2205).
The EHEA showed a significantly lower corrosion rate of ~1 mm/year at 450 °C compared to ~8 mm/year for DS2205.
Similarly, EHEA showed a lower corrosion rate of ~9 mm/year at 650 °C compared to ~20 mm/year for DS2205.
